title: Fair Text Classification with Wasserstein Independence

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating fairness in occupation classification using the Bias in Bios dataset by measuring the Equality of Opportunity GAP, Distance To Optimum (DTO), and Leakage metrics across male and female biographies.

Assessing sentiment classification fairness on the Moji dataset by measuring GAP, DTO, and Leakage metrics across tweets written in Standard American English (SAE) versus African American English (AAE).
